Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 54: the slip of [[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploys and moves like a starfighter. May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Your [Independent Starship] starships may deploy here as a 'react.' If Jabba here, immune to attrition.”), word for word the text of [[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Virtual Block 3)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
